fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) has risen approximately 1,010% over the past 5 years, with fiscal year 2026 Q4 revenue surging to $54.2 billion (+380% YoY) and non-GAAP EPS reaching $33.42 (+1,000% YoY).
fields.summary_ko.1: It holds a strong position with 18% HBM market share and 21% DRAM market share, supported by SK Hynix's 50% pre-sales of production for 2027-2028 and sustained demand outlook through 2030 underpinning future growth.
fields.summary_ko.2: While concerns about memory cycle weakness exist, the current high gross margin of 81% and expanding AI infrastructure demand provide a positive medium-term growth outlook.
